title: Generation parameter tuning and fallback policy repair
protocol_sha256_definition: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON produced after omitting protocol_sha256, sorting keys recursively, and using separators=(',', ':'); stored value is prefixed sha256:.

pytest_baseline.host_warning: Pytest cache ACL warning is included in the three warnings; no test failed.

g1_offline_sizing.source_fields: usage.output_tokens_actual and usage.reasoning_tokens_actual in the two raw JSONL artifacts
g1_offline_sizing.derivation: 8192 is the next power-of-two cap above the Gate 12-V observed completion p95=5407 and max=5941; it leaves 2251 tokens above the prior observed maximum. B4 is censored at 2048 and cannot supply an uncensored maximum. The 262144-token context window makes this cap structurally feasible.
g1_offline_sizing.content_vs_reasoning_observation: Gate 12-V recorded approximately 84 visible content tokens versus approximately 410 reasoning tokens on a realistic prompt; the output cap is therefore consumed mainly by reasoning rather than answer text.

g2_reasoning_control.implementation_requirement: OpenRouter client accepts an optional reasoning mapping and environment-backed reasoning configuration; unset configuration sends no reasoning field, so G3—not source preference—selects the carried setting.
expected_effects_to_measure: lower latency when reasoning is reduced or disabled
possible correctness loss on multi-step questions
whether the configured Nemotron endpoint honors, ignores, or rejects the reasoning field
g2_reasoning_control.configured_primary_catalog_note: The frozen Gate 11-OR-I catalog recorded Nemotron response_format and structured_outputs support; it did not establish reasoning-parameter support. G3 wire payloads and usage/response behavior are the authorized test of honor/ignore/reject.

g3_probe.sample_source: The frozen Gate 12-V 40-question sample, selected without reading expected_answer.
measurements_per_configuration: HTTP status and typed error taxonomy

selection_criteria_frozen_before_probe.hard_safety: Reject a configuration from selection if any request is paid/non-free, the free guard is bypassed, or max_tokens/reasoning wire fields do not match its registered configuration.
primary_order: Prefer finish_reason=length rate <= 0.05; a configuration above 0.05 cannot outrank one at or below 0.05.
Among the remaining configurations, maximize hand-adjudicated correct answers over the eight answerable probe questions; missing/unserved answers are not correct.
Prefer fewer provider-availability failures (HTTP/provider errors with no served model); evidence-based refusals remain separate and are not counted as availability failures.
Maximize first-attempt schema-valid count over provider-attempted rows.
Minimize end-to-end latency p95, then reasoning-token p95.
Fixed final tie-break order: cfg3, cfg4, cfg2, cfg1.
selection_criteria_frozen_before_probe.no_threshold_revision: The Gate 12-V thresholds remain acceptance thresholds for G5; the G3 ranking only selects a measured configuration and cannot change them.
selection_criteria_frozen_before_probe.availability_caveat: A small probe does not establish day-stable provider availability; G3 and G5 must report raw 502/429 counts and distinguish availability variance from configuration effects.

request_budget.pace: strictly under 20 requests/minute including retries and fallbacks

stop_conditions: stop if the free guard cannot verify a configured slug
stop on any paid/non-free catalog observation
stop if daily allowance is insufficient for the registered budget

g4_fallback_policy.fallback_eligible_class: Only upstream provider errors: typed provider_error with HTTP 5xx or an HTTP-200 embedded upstream error such as code=502 and no choices.
g4_fallback_policy.rate_limit_class: HTTP 429 or an error envelope/headers identifying account rate limiting (Retry-After or X-RateLimit-*); wait according to Retry-After and retry the same model, never switch models because of this class.
g4_fallback_policy.other_typed_failures: Timeout, network, authentication, invalid request, finish_reason=length, and malformed response do not trigger model fallback.
g4_fallback_policy.global_governor: One process-global governor counts every generation POST, including primary, fallback, and same-model retry, at a minimum interval that remains strictly under 20 RPM.
g4_fallback_policy.daily_ledger: Every dispatched generation POST increments the daily ledger regardless of HTTP status or response outcome.
offline_tests: HTTP 429 with Retry-After does not fire fallback and retries the same model
governor count includes fallback and retry
non-free fallback slug is refused before transport
g4_fallback_policy.existing_test_gap: Existing tests exercised the fallback mechanism and a retry-after retry, but did not assert the policy boundary separating account rate limits from upstream provider errors.

g5_rerun.protocol_requirement: A fresh committed protocol is required immediately before the first G5 generation POST and must carry the G3-selected configuration, G4 policy, unchanged thresholds, and the exact Gate 12-V sample hash.
g5_rerun.sample: Reuse Gate 12-V frozen 40-question sample exactly; no rescoring of prior gates.

scoring_columns: hand adjudication for every answerable row
required_headlines: fallback issued/rate-limited/served models vs B4 16/16/0 Gemma
